input.installation_name: Elk Prairie VA Medical Center (Elk Prairie VA Health Care System)
input.location: 2500 North Veterans Parkway, Elk Prairie, Wisconsin 54999; CBOCs at Pine Hollow, Ellery, Marston and Tamarack Lake, WI
input.notes: Network Contracting Office 12. Campus approx. 186 acres; 34 existing buildings totaling 1,904,330 GSF incl. parking garage, plus Bldg 300 under construction (Optional Line Item 1001). Base period 1 Oct 2027 - 30 Sep 2028 plus four 12-month options (5 years). Pricing basis is Total CSF (Column 12), not GSF (Note 2, Q&A 1). Grounds maintenance, snow/ice removal and parking lot sweeping are performed by Engineering Service, not this contract (Note 7(j)); contractor covers only building entrances, vestibules and exterior within 10 ft of each entrance. Climate zone inferred from Wisconsin location; growing season not stated. Amendment 0001 (12 Apr 2027) revises Attachment B; proposals due 28 April 2027.

Payments 1 Oct 2022 - 28 Feb 2027 (53 months) total $30,912,764.18. Total award/ceiling value and contract type not stated. Scope differs from this solicitation: Buildings 102 and 103 were added by modification in 2024.

input.summary: Elk Prairie VA Medical Center EMS housekeeping (36C25227R0014, Attachment B with Amendment 0001). Registered all 35 rows of Table B-1 (26 in-scope buildings in Groups A-C; Group D: 6 excluded, 2 vacant, Bldg 300 option-only under Optional Line Item 1001) and all 4 rows of Table B-2 (3 CBOCs in scope, Marston excluded). Gross = Column (8) GSF (information only); cleanable = Column (12) Total CSF, the pricing basis. Amendment 0001 applied: T-38 deleted, Building 41 (B-41) added (9,600 GSF / 7,960 CSF, Code D), Bldg 9 Total CSF 26,690, Bldg 16 Chapel Code G -> Code F. Revised in-scope CSF per amendment: Table B-1 875,165 + CBOCs 33,380 = 908,545. Incumbent Brightwater Environmental Services Group, LLC (36C25222C0087), OY4 $7,316,480/yr, $30,912,764.18 paid over 53 months. No grounds in scope (Note 7(j)).
unresolved: Table B-3 (Building 1 CSF by floor and unit) is a breakdown of B-1 line 1 and was not registered as separate rows; its Code D portions (floor 7 offices 27,920 CSF, floor 6 Specialty Clinic areas 9,150 SF) are recorded in Building 1 notes while the building is priced at Code A (as Table B-4 counts it).
Note 6: in Code A and Code B buildings, low-risk office suites are serviced Mon-Fri (Code D) unless noted otherwise; building-level service levels reflect the building's printed code.

No grounds quantities: grounds maintenance, snow/ice removal and parking lot sweeping are by Engineering Service (Note 7(j)); contractor covers only entrances, vestibules and exterior within 10 ft of each entrance (no area given).
Building 41 is printed as 'Building 41 (B-41)' in Amendment 0001; registered as building number 41.
Former Laundry (Bldg 23) recorded as vacant per remarks; demolition is planned FY2029.
